advisory.headline: Cuba departures are paused for the winter 2026-27 season.
advisory.sentence: Cuba departures are paused for the whole winter 2026-27 season, so I have pulled the closest all-inclusive matches from Montreal for the same week.

packages.resort_name: Cofresi Palm Beach Resort and Spa
packages.price_sentence: Cofresi Palm Beach Resort and Spa in Puerto Plata is 1,890 dollars per person, or 3,780 dollars for the two of you, all-inclusive for 7 nights.
packages.beach: Long calm stretch of Cofresi beach, protected bay
packages.vibe: Relaxed, family and couples mix, quiet by 10pm
packages.why_match: Closest match on price and the calmest beach of the three.
packages.why_match_sentence: This is the closest match on price, and Cofresi beach is a long protected bay, so it is calm rather than a party strip.
packages.flight_summary: WestJet, direct from Montreal to Puerto Plata
packages.flight_detail: Depart Montreal 07:40, arrive Puerto Plata 12:05. Return departs 13:00, arrives Montreal 19:15.
inclusions: All meals and snacks: buffet plus 6 a la carte restaurants
Non-motorized watersports: kayaks, paddleboards, snorkelling gear
important_info: 2 a la carte dinner reservations included per stay
packages.option_line: **Option 1 - Cofresi Palm Beach Resort and Spa**, Puerto Plata - **$1,890 per person** - closest match on price, and Cofresi beach is a long protected bay rather than a party strip.

packages.price_sentence: Bluebay Villas Doradas is 1,955 dollars per person, or 3,910 dollars for the two of you, all-inclusive for 7 nights.
packages.beach: Playa Dorada, long protected stretch, quietest of the three
packages.why_match: Adults only and the quietest beach, for 65 dollars more per person.
packages.why_match_sentence: This one is adults only and the quietest of the three, for 65 dollars more per person than the Cofresi.

packages.vibe: Greener and more remote, nature focused
packages.why_match: The February whale season in Samana Bay, if they want something different from Varadero.
packages.why_match_sentence: This is the one to pick if they want something genuinely different. February is humpback whale season in Samana Bay.

packages.option_line: **Option 3 - Eurostars Grand Cayacoa**, Samana - **$2,140 per person** - clifftop with a private cove, and February is humpback whale season in Samana Bay.

basis_sentence: All three are all-inclusive, 7 nights, flying from Montreal on the same week you asked about.
price_gap_sentence: One thing to flag: at $1,890 per person the first one runs about $190 more than a typical Varadero February. Cuba capacity coming out of the market has pushed Dominican pricing up for the peak weeks, so this is the closest I can get you on price without moving your dates.
closing_sentence: Checkout will already have the package, the dates, the room, your extras and the price filled in. The only thing left to type is who is travelling.
